verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Linear supports identity verification via Okta and centralized admin-managed access without individual sign-in (SSO-like flow), and MCP access tied to Okta-managed identity, which implies enterprise SSO/SCIM support. However, none of the evidence explicitly names SAML or details support for other SSO providers/protocols beyond Okta. Missing for 10: explicit mention of SAML protocol, support for multiple IdPs (e.g., Azure AD, Google Workspace), and admin console SSO setup documentation.
